verses.html: To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah. LORD, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.
verses.text: To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah. LORD, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.
verses.title: To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.
verses.titleHtml: To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.

verses.html: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.
verses.text: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.

verses.html: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned thyself from the fierceness of thine anger.
verses.text: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned thyself from the fierceness of thine anger.

verses.html: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease.
verses.text: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease.

verses.html: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?
verses.text: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?

verses.html: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
verses.text: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?

verses.html: Shew us thy mercy, O LORD, and grant us thy salvation.
verses.text: Shew us thy mercy, O LORD, and grant us thy salvation.

verses.html: I will hear what God the LORD will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.
verses.text: I will hear what God the LORD will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.

verses.html: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.
verses.text: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.

verses.html: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
verses.text: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

verses.html: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.
verses.text: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.

verses.html: Yea, the LORD shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.
verses.text: Yea, the LORD shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.

verses.html: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set us in the way of his steps.
verses.text: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set us in the way of his steps.
